candidate.user_submission: Di pikin never get convulsion and e no dey convulse now. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. Di pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count di pikin breath for one minute. Di chest dey go inside when e dey breathe. Di pikin calm when I check am. E don dey cough for 3 days. Pulse oximeter no dey. E no dey get wheeze before. E dey breathe 35 times for one minute. No stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze.
